text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove wins the Shuka Sho and is crowned Triple Tiara champion, showing Mejiro Dober an ideal to aspire toward in the process.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Finally, she has achieved one of her major aims as Empress.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She journeys on toward even greater heights in order to be a beacon for all Umamusume.
